div.head: Geþyncðo 4
div.ab: 7 se þe swa geþogenne forwyrhtan næfde, swore for sylfne æfter his rihte, oððe his þolode.
Et qui sic promotum hominem non habet, ipse causam suam superiuret uel amittat.
And se ðe swa geþogene forwyrhtan næfde, swore for silfne æfter his rihte, oððe his þolode.
And he who had no such distinguished representative, swore in person to obtain his rights, or lost his case.
And he who did not have such a worthy representative swore for himself to his rights or forfeited his case.
Und wer einen so hochgestiegenen Vertreter nicht hatte, der musste für sich selbst, um sein Recht [zu erstreiten,] schwören oder verlor es [seinen Process].
And whoever did not have so high-risen a representative had to swear for himself to [win] his right, or lost it [his suit].
